main_measure.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess 5-bar return (split at median forecast)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2 and supporting check; reject: difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return of upper-half cases > 0

decided_by: The difference is above 0 with Welch t >= 2 and the upper half's mean excess return is above 0.
reading: The 20-day return is recomputed as close[t]/close[t-20]-1 inside each window, so active bars of a window's first 20 rows are left out of the agreement; the trending regime for cases is the record's `regime` column; the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of all its non-overlapping grid returns over all its windows; the median is taken over all cases of all coins pooled; returns are fractions.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
